description: 3 hosts, Austria/Tanzania-style: portal front-ends (records/species/regions) split by PATH under ONE shared hostname across all three hosts, instead of each on its own subdomain. Otherwise identical to default-3host. Exercises the cross-host shared-vhost stub proxying mechanism (la-compose nginx_shared_vhost_topology / register-shared-vhost-stubs.yml) for the PORTAL, the real-world need documented in ala-install issue discussions (Austria prod, Tanzania demo) and in the FAQ "Should I use subdomains or pathnames".
